task.instruction: Choose the first onboarding experiment for a workspace where invited members often stop before joining.
task.deliverable: A prioritized experiment, one protected constraint, and evidence citations.

evidence.content: Synthetic funnel data show 31% abandon at role selection and 28% abandon when the invitation purpose is unclear.
Six invented interview summaries split evenly: three requested role previews and three requested a clearer invitation explanation.
A synthetic consent-flow review requires an invitee to be able to decline before account creation; forcing an account first would create an unrequested record.

A.content: When uncertainty is material, preserve room to compare distinct hypotheses before narrowing the choice.

B.content: When evidence is sufficient, narrow the choice and direct effort toward one coherent course of action.

irrelevant.content: Use one consistent date format throughout the deliverable.
